Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Justin Etherington
Message:
Rotate out committed Postmark token and add CI secret scanning

Removed the live Postmark ServerToken committed in src/HR.Api/appsettings.json
(introduced in e0b77ef8, 28 Aug 2026) and replaced it with an empty placeholder
sourced from environment/secret-store config in non-dev environments. Added a
gitleaks secret-scan job to .github/workflows/ci.yml, wired into the required
ci-success gate, so future committed secrets fail CI. Documented the exposure
and outstanding manual follow-ups (token revocation, Postmark activity review,
git history rewrite) in docs/incidents/2026-09-postmark-token-exposure.md.

Assumption: gitleaks-action was chosen for secret scanning since it integrates
directly with the existing GitHub Actions CI setup with no extra infra.
